note: Aliases: pivot. 'source' required (e.g. Sheet1!A1:D100). External workbook refs rejected. Position auto-placed after source if omitted. Field axes (rows/cols/filters/values) take comma-separated field names; values use 'Field:agg' tuples. Query returns child nodes typed pivotfield/pivotrow/pivotcolumn/pivotdata — these are read-only structural nodes, not independently addressable elements; no Add/Set/Remove is supported on them.

source.description: source range. Alias: src. External workbook refs rejected.

position.description: anchor cell (e.g. H1). Alias: pos. Auto-placed after source if omitted.

style.description: built-in or workbook custom pivot style name (e.g. PivotStyleMedium9).

rows.description: row-axis field names, comma-separated (e.g. 'Region,Category'). Aliases: row, rowField, rowFields.

cols.description: column-axis field names, comma-separated. Aliases: col, column, columns, colField, colFields, columnField, columnFields.

filters.description: page/filter-axis field names, comma-separated. Aliases: filter, filterField, filterFields.

values.description: value-axis fields as 'Field:agg' tuples, comma-separated (e.g. 'Sales:sum,Qty:avg'). agg one of sum, avg, count, max, min, product, stdev, stdevp, var, varp, countNums. Aliases: value, valueField, valueFields.

aggregate.description: default aggregate for value fields when omitted from --prop values. One of sum, avg, count, max, min, product, stdev, stdevp, var, varp, countNums.

showDataAs.description: value-field display mode: normal, percentOfTotal, percentOfRow, percentOfCol, runningTotal. (percentOfParent / rankAscending / rankDescending / index / difference / percentDifference are not yet supported.)

topN.description: keep only top-N row keys ranked by first value field's aggregate. Integer >= 1; filter applied to source rows pre-cache. Add-time only — Set ignores this key.

labelFilter.description: label filter as 'field:type:value' (e.g. 'Region:beginsWith:N'). Type one of equals, notEquals, beginsWith, endsWith, contains, doesNotContain. Add-time only — Set ignores this key.

calculatedField.description: user-defined formula field as 'Name:=Formula' (e.g. 'Margin:=Sales-Cost'). Use calculatedField1, calculatedField2, ... for multiple. Alias: calculatedFields. Add-time only — Set ignores this key.

repeatLabels.description: repeat outer-axis item labels on every row (fillDown). Aliases: repeatItemLabels, repeatAllLabels, fillDownLabels.

blankRows.description: insert a blank row after each outer item group. Aliases: insertBlankRow, insertBlankRows, blankRow, blankLine, blankLines.

grandTotals.description: grand-total visibility. 'rows' = show grand-total row only; 'cols' = show grand-total column only; 'both'/'on'/'true' = both; 'none'/'off'/'false' = neither.

rowGrandTotals.description: show row-axis grand totals. Independent of colGrandTotals.

colGrandTotals.description: show column-axis grand totals. Alias: columnGrandTotals.

grandTotalCaption.description: label text for the Grand Total row/column (default 'Grand Total').

defaultSubtotal.description: default-subtotal flag for new pivot fields (per-field <pivotField defaultSubtotal=...>).

showRowStripes.description: banded-row striping in the pivot style. Alias: bandedRows.

showColStripes.description: banded-column striping in the pivot style. Aliases: showColumnStripes, bandedCols, bandedColumns.

showColHeaders.description: show column-axis header formatting. Alias: showColumnHeaders.

showLastColumn.description: highlight the last column in the pivot style.

showDrill.description: show expand/collapse (+/-) buttons on every pivot field. Add-time only — Set ignores this key.

mergeLabels.description: merge+center repeated outer-axis item cells (<pivotTableDefinition mergeItem='1'>). Add-time only — Set ignores this key.

cacheId.description: pivot cache index (read-only; assigned by Excel when the pivot table is created).
cacheId.readback: pivot cache index (read-only; assigned by Excel)

fieldCount.description: total number of pivot fields in the source range (read-only).
fieldCount.readback: total number of pivot fields in the source range

dataFieldCount.description: number of data field aggregations (read-only; equals the count of dataField{N} entries).

dataField{N}.description: per-data-field readback (1-indexed: dataField1, dataField2, …) packed as 'name:aggFunc:fieldIdx'. Get also returns `dataField{N}.showAs` when ShowDataAs != normal.
dataField{N}.readback: packed as 'name:aggFunc:fieldIdx'; name reflects Excel's stored DataField/@name which includes auto-prefixes (e.g. 'Sum of Revenue:sum:1')

dataField{N}.showAs.description: data field showAs token (read-only). Values are canonicalized from OOXML ShowDataAs.

location.description: target cell range where the pivot table is rendered (e.g. D1:E4).

collapsedFields.description: comma-separated names of fields with collapsed items.

axisAsDataField.description: comma-separated names of fields acting as data field on axis.
